propositions.name: new_beings_first_appear
propositions.statement: The first appearance of new beings on this earth is a great fact and a mystery of mysteries.
propositions.quote: we seem to be brought somewhat near to that great fact—that mystery of mysteries—the first appearance of new beings on this earth.

propositions.name: aboriginal_creations_found_nowhere_else
propositions.statement: Most of the organic productions of the archipelago are aboriginal creations found nowhere else.
propositions.quote: Most of the organic productions are aboriginal creations, found nowhere else; there is even a difference between the inhabitants of the different islands

propositions.name: islands_geologically_recent
propositions.statement: The islands were, within a geologically recent period, covered by the unbroken ocean.
propositions.quote: we are led to believe that within a period, geologically recent, the unbroken ocean was here spread out

propositions.name: islands_never_united
propositions.statement: The profound depth of ocean and recent volcanic origin make it highly unlikely the islands were ever united.
propositions.quote: the profound depth of the ocean between the islands, and their apparently recent (in a geological sense) volcanic origin, render it highly unlikely that they were ever united

propositions.name: created_on_american_types
propositions.statement: The aboriginal inhabitants of the Galapagos were created on American types of organization.
propositions.quote: why were they created on American types of organization? It is probable that the islands of the Cape de Verd group resemble

propositions.name: rat_variety_produced_by_conditions
propositions.statement: The James Island rat is merely a variety produced by the new and peculiar climate, food, and soil.
propositions.quote: this rat is merely a variety, produced by the new and peculiar climate, food, and soil, to which it has been subjected

propositions.name: created_in_centre_then_dispersed
propositions.statement: The terrestrial Amblyrhynchus appears created in the centre of the archipelago and thence dispersed only a certain distance.
propositions.quote: It would appear as if it had been created in the centre of the archipelago, and thence had been dispersed only to a certain distance

propositions.name: instinct_becomes_hereditary_over_generations
propositions.statement: An instinct not acquired by individuals in a short time becomes hereditary in the course of successive generations.
propositions.quote: it is not acquired by individual birds in a short time, even when much persecuted; but that in the course of successive generations it becomes hereditary

propositions.name: acquired_habits_rendered_hereditary
propositions.statement: In domesticated animals new mental habits or instincts are acquired and rendered hereditary.
propositions.quote: With domesticated animals we are accustomed to see new mental habits or instincts acquired and rendered hereditary

propositions.name: fixed_hereditary_instinct_governs_lizard
propositions.statement: The marine Amblyrhynchus is urged by a fixed and hereditary instinct that the shore is its place of safety.
propositions.quote: urged by a fixed and hereditary instinct that the shore is its place of safety, whatever the emergency may be, it there takes refuge

propositions.name: wildness_particular_instinct_against_man
propositions.statement: The wildness of birds with regard to man is a particular instinct directed against him, not general caution.
propositions.quote: the wildness of birds with regard to man, is a particular instinct directed against him , and not dependent on any general degree of caution arising from other sources of danger

propositions.name: creative_force_displayed_on_islands
propositions.statement: An amount of creative force is displayed on these small, barren, and rocky islands.
propositions.quote: one is astonished at the amount of creative force, if such an expression may be used, displayed on these small, barren, and rocky islands

propositions.name: different_islands_different_beings
propositions.statement: The different islands are to a considerable extent inhabited by a different set of beings.
propositions.quote: the different islands to a considerable extent are inhabited by a different set of beings. My attention was first called to this fact

propositions.name: physical_conditions_similar_across_islands
propositions.statement: Soil, height, climate, and associated beings cannot differ much among the different islands.
propositions.quote: neither the nature of the soil, nor height of the land, nor the climate, nor the general character of the associated beings, and therefore their action one on another, can differ much in the different islands

propositions.name: species_may_be_only_races
propositions.statement: Some representative species may hereafter prove to be only well-marked races, of equally great interest.
propositions.quote: may hereafter prove to be only well-marked races; but this would be of equally great interest to the philosophical naturalist

propositions.name: beaks_insensibly_graduated
propositions.statement: The finch genus Geospiza contains six species with insensibly graduated beaks rather than one intermediate species.
propositions.quote: instead of there being only one intermediate species, with a beak, of the size shown in Fig. 2, there are no less than six species with insensibly graduated beaks

propositions.name: one_species_modified_for_different_ends
propositions.statement: One might fancy that from an original paucity of birds one species had been taken and modified for different ends.
propositions.quote: one might really fancy that from an original paucity of birds in this archipelago, one species had been taken and modified for different ends

propositions.name: calcareous_eggs_transported_more_easily
propositions.statement: Lizard eggs protected by calcareous shells might be transported through salt-water more easily than the slimy spawn of frogs.
propositions.quote: May this difference not be caused, by the greater facility with which the eggs of lizards, protected by calcareous shells, might be transported through salt-water, than could the slimy spawn of frogs?

propositions.name: archipelago_zoologically_american
propositions.statement: The archipelago, though in the Pacific Ocean, is zoologically part of America.
propositions.quote: we see that this archipelago, though standing in the Pacific Ocean, is zoologically part of America. If this character were owing merely to immigrants from America

propositions.name: cape_verde_stamped_with_africa
propositions.statement: Cape de Verd inhabitants bear the impress of Africa as Galapagos inhabitants are stamped with that of America.
propositions.quote: those of the Cape de Verd Islands bearing the impress of Africa, as the inhabitants of the Galapagos Archipelago are stamped with that of America

propositions.name: physical_similarity_does_not_determine_biota
propositions.statement: Cape de Verd islands resemble the Galapagos physically more than the Galapagos resemble America, yet their inhabitants differ.
propositions.quote: the islands of the Cape de Verd group resemble, in all their physical conditions, far more closely the Galapagos Islands than these latter physically resemble the coast of America

propositions.name: ocean_currents_separate_islands
propositions.statement: Strong westerly and W.N.W. sea currents separate the southern islands from the northern ones as far as transportal by the sea is concerned.
propositions.quote: very strong currents of the sea running in a westerly and W.N.W. direction must separate, as far as transportal by the sea is concerned, the southern islands from the northern ones

propositions.name: reptiles_replace_herbivorous_mammalia
propositions.statement: The order of reptiles replaces the herbivorous mammalia in this archipelago as in no other quarter of the world.
propositions.quote: there is no other quarter of the world where this Order replaces the herbivorous mammalia in so extraordinary a manner

propositions.name: mouth_form_adaptation_to_herbivory
propositions.statement: The tortoise-like form of the Amblyrhynchus mouth is an adaptation to their herbivorous appetites.
propositions.quote: the form of the mouth may almost be compared to that of the tortoise: one is led to suppose that this is an adaptation to their herbivorous appetites

propositions.name: buzzard_induced_to_new_office
propositions.statement: One might fancy a bird originally a buzzard had been induced to undertake the office of the American carrion-feeding Polybori.
propositions.quote: it might be fancied that a bird originally a buzzard, had been induced here to undertake the office of the carrion-feeding Polybori of the American continent

propositions.name: tortoise_aboriginal_to_galapagos
propositions.statement: The tortoise is an aboriginal inhabitant of the Galapagos, found on all or nearly all the islands.
propositions.quote: There can be little doubt that this tortoise is an aboriginal inhabitant of the Galapagos; for it is found on all, or nearly all, the islands

propositions.name: aquatic_forms_less_peculiar
propositions.statement: Aquatic forms, marine or fresh-water, are less peculiar at any given point of the earth's surface than terrestrial forms of the same classes.
propositions.quote: this law of aquatic forms, whether marine or fresh-water, being less peculiar at any given point of the earth's surface than the terrestrial forms of the same classes

propositions.name: same_causes_make_species_smaller_duskier
propositions.statement: The same causes that make immigrant species smaller here also make the peculiar Galapageian species smaller and duskier coloured.
propositions.quote: the same causes which here make the immigrants of some species smaller, make most of the peculiar Galapageian species also smaller, as well as very generally more dusky coloured

propositions.name: representative_species_fill_same_place
propositions.statement: Several islands possess their own species of tortoise, mocking-thrush, finches, and plants having the same habits and occupying analogous situations.
propositions.quote: several of the islands possess their own species of the tortoise, mocking-thrush, finches, and numerous plants, these species having the same general habits, occupying analogous situations

propositions.name: archipelago_derived_stray_colonists
propositions.statement: The archipelago is a satellite attached to America whence it has derived a few stray colonists.
propositions.quote: The archipelago is a little world within itself, or rather a satellite attached to America, whence it has derived a few stray colonists

propositions.name: plants_confined_to_single_islands
propositions.statement: Of thirty-eight Galapageian plants in James Island, thirty are exclusively confined to that one island.
propositions.quote: in James Island, of the thirty-eight Galapageian plants, or those found in no other part of the world, thirty are exclusively confined to this one island

propositions.name: driftwood_washed_from_continent
propositions.statement: Drift-wood, bamboos, canes, and palm nuts are often washed onto the south-eastern shores of the archipelago.
propositions.quote: drift-wood, bamboos, canes, and the nuts of a palm, are often washed on the south-eastern shores
